verdict.rationale: Luma's own docs describe Luma Agents that carry out multi-step video and image workflows, and 'Luma Skills', billed as building a creative workflow once and running it forever. That points to reusable, agent-driven automation. Nothing documents scheduled or triggered background runs, though, so this reads as re-runnable workflows rather than recurring autonomous automation. Missing for 10: scheduling or trigger configuration, evidence of unattended background execution, detailed Skills/Agents docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
